strategy.positioning_statement: For people in hot, humid Indian cities, Velvaa Skin's Saffron Dew Serum offers lightweight, non-sticky texture that absorbs quickly. What sets it apart: rooted in familiar Indian ingredients.
strategy.primary_kpi: Purchase conversion rate, CPA and ROAS

segments.name: People in hot, humid Indian cities
pain_points: Products that don't feel heavy or sticky in the heat
segments.message: Saffron Dew Serum: Lightweight, non-sticky texture that absorbs quickly

segments.name: Skincare beginners who want a short routine
pain_points: A simple routine that is easy to stick to
segments.message: Saffron Dew Serum: Saffron extract with 5% niacinamide

segments.name: People who prefer fragrance-free, gentle products
pain_points: Avoiding added fragrance and harsh feel
segments.message: Saffron Dew Serum: Fragrance-free and suitable for daily use
